content.body: If anybody is familiar with `window.open()` and user activation, I would love to hear your input on https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/13169 I spent the whole morning debugging why Servo fails this test and I think either the spec is wrong or browsers do something with blessing the wrong document. But maybe I am missing something completely, so do let me know if I missed a step.
